design_gotchas.title: FCCM Light-Load Efficiency Collapse (~12% at 5 mA) & 2.9x Higher IQ vs Pin-Identical TPS563201DDCR
design_gotchas.detail: TPS563208DDCR is the Forced Continuous Conduction Mode (FCCM, marking '3208') twin of Eco-mode TPS563201DDCR ('3201'). Maintaining continuous 580 kHz switching eliminates audible PFM burst ripple and VOUT Eco-mode uplift, but raises non-switching IQ from 120 uA to 350 uA typ (500 uA max, p.6) and drops 5 mA efficiency from ~80% (Fig. 5-13) to ~12% (Fig. 5-18)—avoid on battery standby rails.

design_gotchas.title: 17 V Max Input (19 V Abs Max) Fails on 24 V Buses Built for Pin-Identical TPS54302DDCR
design_gotchas.detail: TPS563208DDCR shares the SOT-23-6 pinout (1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=VFB, 5=EN, 6=VBST) with TPS54302DDCR, TPS54202DDCR, and AP62300WU-7, yet its 17 V operating / 19 V abs max input and 7.0 V VOUT ceiling cannot survive 24 V rails. Dropping it onto a 0.596 V TPS54302 divider also causes +28.9% overvoltage (3.3 V jumps to 4.25 V).

design_gotchas.title: Floating EN Disables TPS563208 (Internal 1.5 MOhm Pulldown) — Opposite of TPS54302 & AP62300
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike float-to-enable TPS54302DDCR and AP62300WU-7, TPS563208 integrates a 1.5 MOhm (600–2400 kOhm) pulldown on Pin 5 (EN), holding the converter OFF if floated (p.6). Conversely, EN survives 19 V abs max and can tie directly to a 12 V VIN bus (which destroys 7 V/8 V-capped peers).

design_gotchas.title: Incompatible Pinout vs AP63300/AP63203 and D-CAP2 20–68 uF Ceramic COUT Window
design_gotchas.detail: Do NOT cross-populate TPS563208DDCR with Diodes AP63300WU-7 or AP63203WU-7 (which scramble pins to 1=FB, 2=EN, 3=VIN, 4=GND, 5=SW, 6=BST). Also observe Table 7-2 ceramic COUT bounds (20–68 uF, p.15) and note FCCM can sink reverse inductor current from pre-biased rails once switching begins.

typical_use_cases: Audio, RF, ADC, and noise-sensitive 5 V/12 V point-of-load 3 A buck rails requiring fixed 580 kHz FCCM without audible PFM jitter
Pin-for-pin low-ripple FCCM substitute for Eco-mode TPS563201DDCR in wall-powered set-top boxes, routers, and surveillance gear
Tight-regulation FPGA/ASIC core and I/O rails (1.05 V, 1.8 V, 3.3 V, 5.0 V) eliminating Eco-mode light-load output voltage uplift
Compact SOT-23-6 3 A synchronous buck with pre-biased monotonic 1.0 ms soft-start and 95/57 mOhm integrated FETs
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TPS563208DDCR is a 4.5 V to 17 V input (19 V abs max), 3 A continuous synchronous buck converter in SOT-23-6 (DDC) running D-CAP2 control in Forced Continuous Conduction Mode (FCCM) at 580 kHz typ (95/57 mOhm FETs, ~96% peak at 5 V->3.3 V, ~93% at 12 V->5 V). It is the pin-identical low-ripple FCCM sibling of Eco-mode TPS563201DDCR, keeping switching frequency constant across light loads at the expense of 350 uA typ IQ and steep sub-50 mA efficiency drop (~12% at 5 mA). Engineers swapping across SOT-23-6 peers must verify its 17 V VIN cap, 0.768 V VFB, 20–68 uF COUT bounds, and internal 1.5 MOhm EN pulldown.

audit_notes: 300 DPI PNG Vision on p.3 confirmed DDC 6-pin SOT-23-THIN Top View pinout (1=GND, 2=SW, 3=VIN, 4=VFB, 5=EN, 6=VBST) with no exposed thermal pad.
300 DPI PNG Vision on p.4–5 confirmed Abs Max (VIN/EN/SW = 19 V, TJ = -40..150°C), Rec Op (VIN = 4.5–17 V, TJ = -40..125°C), and DDC Thermal Info (RθJA = 92.6 °C/W, RθJC(top) = 48.5 °C/W).

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.6 confirmed TPS563208-specific IQ = 350 uA typ / 500 uA max (vs 120/200 uA on TPS563201), IVINSDN = 8 uA typ / 20 uA max, REN = 1500 kOhm pulldown, VFBTH = 768 mV CCM, RDS(on) = 95/57 mOhm, Iocl = 3.3–5.1 A (4.2 A typ), and Fsw = 580 kHz.

300 DPI PNG Vision on p.9 confirmed TPS563208 Efficiency plots (Fig. 5-17 peaks ~96% at 5 V->3.3 V; Fig. 5-18 peaks ~93% at 12 V->5 V and drops to ~12% at 5 mA due to FCCM vs ~80% Eco-mode in Fig. 5-13); Path A verified Active Production OPN TPS563208DDCR (marking '3208', p.28).
